title: Jazzed German Mackerel Bisque
description: A soothing and cultured German dish, featuring smoked mackerel, perfect for a sick day. This keto-friendly bisque is a delightful twist on a classic German recipe.
instructions: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add all-purpose flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly browned.
Gradually add fish stock, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Stir in heavy cream, white wine, lemon juice, chopped dill, salt, and black pepper.
Add smoked mackerel fillets to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Use an immersion blender to puree the bisque until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
